calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-26-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288
Petitioners Mimi Yuen Mei Ong (mother) was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minor Justin Kuo Shuaan Liang, placed under oath and examined.
Declaration by Minor's Father Clavin Kai Liang filed 03-21-12 consenting to the name change of the minor.
Proof of Publication is in the file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to Justin Yu Cheng Liang.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court
